semiconductor_relevance: High — Saratoga Technology International supplies a range of equipment specifically for semiconductor processing and manufacturing.
summary: Saratoga Technology International is a prominent equipment supplier catering to the semiconductor industry, including IC processing and wafer manufacturing. They provide a variety of advanced tools and systems essential for the production and testing of semiconductors, LEDs, MEMS, and solar cells.

regional_presence.China: Saratoga Technology International serves a wide range of customers across China, including major IC fabs and solar factories.
